newsitem.title: USA: Mercury sees '96 audit completed in May.
newsitem.headline: Mercury sees '96 audit completed in May.

text.p: Mercury Finance Co does not expect an audit of its 1996 financial results to be completed until May, a spokesman for the automobile financing company said Monday.
"Now we're saying it could be at least 30-45 days, sometime in mid-May," Joseph Kopec, a spokesman for Mercury, said.
On January 29, the company said it overstated its earnings for the last four years by about $90 million because of accounting discrepancies.
It originally said its 1996 results were expected to be released by the end of March.
But the company's appointment last month of Arthur Andersen LLP as auditors, replacing KPMG Peat Marwick, will delay the release of final 1996 results, Kopec said.
